pairs.why: Almost identical; A's slightly brighter red and cleaner lid highlight are a touch nearer the vivid real cards than B's flatter crimson.
Same build, the same soft matte finish and the same lighting; the small difference in width or height doesn't make either one read more like the real cards.
Both are the same clean, smooth hatbox with a mild sheen; the only real difference is A's slightly taller proportions, which changes nothing about style.
Rendering, colour and how solid the object looks are essentially the same in both.
They are practically the same render; there is no visible style gap to judge.
They differ only in stripe placement and a small proportion change, and both match the real cards' smooth, softly lit finish equally well.
B is a bit taller, but the finish, light and colour are the same, and both are built as a believable box.
A is a little taller and B is squatter; the material and lighting are the same, so neither is closer.
